description: Uploads a local audio file (path, or base64 content) to the Jam Jam server queue so that its chords and lyrics are analysed, then automatically aligned, for a song of YOUR notebook (POST /audio). Same queue as the Jam Jam app. "songId" must already exist in the caller's notebook (see jj_list_songs), otherwise 404. Needs an account and the audio:write scope. It returns at once with a job: follow it with jj_queue_get_job. Idempotent per (account, song, file content): sending the same file again returns the same job with reused=true and consumes nothing. Quota: counter "audio-analysis", 15 analyses per ISO week on a free account (resets Monday 00:00 UTC), no limit on Premium; at most 50 jobs may wait per account. Errors: 413 file too large, 415 not audio, 429 quota or queue full.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded audio content. Mutually exclusive with path. Requires "filename".

filename.description: File name (with extension). Required with contentBase64; defaults to the basename of "path".

path.description: Absolute or relative local path to the audio file. Mutually exclusive with contentBase64.

songId.description: Id of an existing song in the caller's notebook (base song id from jj_list_songs).

name: jj_audio_analyze
title: Queue an audio file for chord and lyrics analysis
